_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.lead: Everyone repeats the same origin story for this game
beats.text: The aliens were the third choice, not the first.
beats.note: Tomohiro Nishikado wanted tanks first. He wanted them to face forward to look right, and that stopped working the moment the enemies had to move sideways.

beats.name: Tomohiro Nishikado
beats.role: Designer at Taito. After tanks, he tried planes, but the hardware of the time could not animate believable flight. Aliens worked because jerky, mechanical movement did not look like a mistake on them.

beats.lead: The part people add for free
beats.text: He says it was not about Star Wars.
beats.note: Space Invaders shipped a year after Star Wars and people have assumed a connection ever since. Nishikado's own account credits animation limits and a tank that looked wrong, not the movie.

beats.text: A cornering problem invented the alien shooter.

beats.line: The design that defined a genre was a workaround.
